query_text: which came first the walking dead comic or show

messages.content: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
The **comic came first**. *The Walking Dead* began as a comic book series in **October 2003**, while the TV show premiered on **October 31, 2010**.[1][4]

So if you mean the original source material versus the adaptation, the **comic** came first.[1][4]
